english.title: Fail to notify petroleum enforcement authority in accordance with regulation 10
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to notify the petroleum enforcement authority in accordance with regulation 10 of the Petroleum (Consolidation) Regulations 2014, in that **(..SPECIFY WAY IN WHICH PROHIBITED..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 4, 5 and 10 of the Petroleum (Consolidation) Regulations 2014 and section 33(1)(c) and schedule 3A to the Health and Safety at Work etc. Act 1974.

english.notes:
(i) This offence applies to a person who kept petrol on dispensing premises in respect of which there is a valid storage certificate, but that person is not the person to whom the storage certificate was granted.
(ii) The notification must have been made in writing and state -
(a) the person's name and address;
(b) the address of the dispensing premises; and (c) the date on which the person proposes to commence keeping petrol at the dispensing premises.
(iii) The notification must have been given -
(a) a maximum of six months; and (b) a minimum of 28 days,
before the day on which the person proposes to keep petrol on the dispensing premises.
(iii) A contravention of paragraph (4)(b) does not relieve a person from the duty to notify the petroleum enforcement authority under paragraphs (2) and (3).

other.penalty:
Either Way -

Summary: Maximum 12 months imprisonment / or a fine
Indictment: Maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Notes:
In relation to an offence committed before section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 12 months imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
